name: San Mateo 101 Express Lanes Go Card
description: $200 prepaid transportation card each year for income-eligible San Mateo County residents
fullDescription: The San Mateo 101 Express Lanes Go Card Program helps cover transportation costs for income-eligible San Mateo County residents with a $200 prepaid card each year.
whatTheyOffer:
- $200 prepaid card, available once a year, for transportation purchases
- Use it for public transit, express lanes, toll bridges, paratransit, and bike or scooter rentals
- Accepted by providers such as Clipper, FasTrak, BART, Caltrain, SamTrans, Amtrak, Bay Wheels, and SF Bay Ferry
- Can be used to add funds to Clipper START, Youth, Senior, or RTC cards, or an Express Lanes START FasTrak account
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a San Mateo County resident, age 18 or older
2. Individual annual income at or below $88,260 (60% of Area Median Income); household size is considered if household income is higher
3. Visit or call one of the program's community partners to sign up (see the How to Enroll page)
4. Each eligible household member applies separately
5. Recipients may reapply one year after their initial application
